newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy air traffic controllers sign no-strike pact.
newsitem.headline: Italy air traffic controllers sign no-strike pact.

text.p: Italian air traffic controllers reached an agreement with their state employers on Wednesday which should ensure a strike-free summer at the country's airports, the Transport Ministry said.
The agreement takes effect from July 4 and will last until October 31, the ministry said in a statement.
The agreement introduces an alternative procedure to strike action to resolve local disputes for the first time.
Transport Minister Claudio Burlando said: "It's important that in this sensitive sector we experiment with alternatives to solve disputes along the lines of round-table talks."
Italy has been plagued by strikes by air traffic controllers, who are represented by six different unions, in previous summers.
